description: Harden the public LLM authoring, inspection, visual review, and evidence workflow
deviation_notes: S4 repaired clone-root manifest churn, stale archive routing, and unignored ad-hoc revision outputs. The approved fresh client was kimi-for-coding/k3 through OpenCode. Three.js GLTFLoader was selected as the representative format importer; Unity, Godot, and gameplay runtime remain Not Assessed. The preferred browser harness was unavailable, so the pinned Playwright fallback supplied visual evidence.

sprint.goal: Make the supported static asset workflow independently discoverable, safely editable, visually reviewable, and reproducible by a fresh MCP-capable LLM without source knowledge.
sprint.demo_notes: Phases S1 through S3 are owner-approved. S4 automated verification passes: portable deterministic artifacts, a permission-isolated OpenCode run with kimi-for-coding/k3 through 18 public forge calls, independent visual/artifact audits, a passing Three.js GLTFLoader import, and a fully green differently rooted clean clone. S4 awaits owner manual approval; accessory breadth, novel identities, temporal animation/atlases/animated GLB, equipped-sword readability, and external game engines remain open or Not Assessed.
